name: cceps
comment: Sig: y = cceps(x). Complex cepstrum: ifft(log(fft(x))) with phase unwrapping. Numkit historically applied a forward DFT in the second pass instead of inverse, which time-reversed the output (audit ТЗ signal/cceps closed 2026-05-09 — sign-convention fix in fftRadix2 dir argument). Bit-identical to MATLAB R2025b on the canonical ТЗ probe (1:8). Octave produces a completely different output — its phase-unwrap path differs from MATLAB's; harness already prefers MATLAB. Phase-unwrap convergence on more complex inputs may diverge in the LSBs (separate audit gap, not part of this ТЗ).
